decision: PASS / G3 local and disposable-dependency gate
scope: local source, SQLite regressions, disposable PostgreSQL 16, and isolated disposable Redis outage injection

checks.name: static-and-platform-regression
checks.command: cd platform && uv run --extra dev ruff check api worker cli tests migrations && uv run --extra dev mypy api worker cli && uv run --extra dev pytest -q tests migrations/tests
checks.result: Ruff PASS; mypy PASS for 43 source files; 143 passed, 6 explicitly opt-in service tests skipped

checks.name: producer-boundary
checks.command: cd platform && uv run --extra dev pytest -q tests/test_outbox_relay.py
checks.result: 9 passed; AST gate found the sole production dispatcher.enqueue call in the queue adapter; outbox retry reused the pending attempt without direct publication

checks.name: handoff-fault-injection
checks.result: publish-before-ack crash, double relay claim, execution lease reclaim, late-owner fencing, poison handling, verify/ingest/analyze duplicate suppression, and stale reindex snapshot no-op passed

checks.name: postgresql-16-concurrency
checks.command: CRASH_CAP_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL 16 URL> uv run --extra dev pytest -q tests/test_task_handoff_postgres.py tests/test_analysis_lifecycle_postgres.py
checks.result: 3 passed; SKIP LOCKED relay/worker claims elected one owner and late generation/current-analysis writes were fenced

checks.name: redis-outage-recovery
checks.command: CRASH_CAP_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL 16 URL> CRASH_CAP_TEST_REDIS_URL=<isolated Redis URL> CRASH_CAP_TEST_REDIS_CONTAINER=<exact disposable container> uv run --extra dev pytest -q tests/test_outbox_relay_redis_postgres.py
checks.result: 1 passed; a committed intent remained pending while Redis was stopped, recorded a transient relay error, and was delivered after the exact disposable Redis container restarted

checks.name: deployment-topology
checks.command: cd platform && uv run --extra dev python ../scripts/phase1/deploy_check.py --json
checks.result: static topology accepted a dedicated no-port relay on the data network with PostgreSQL, Redis, and migration dependencies

checks.name: reconciliation-safety
checks.command: cd platform && uv run --extra dev pytest -q tests/test_task_reconciliation.py
checks.result: dry-run and resumable cursor passed; apply creates only task intents and audit rows and requires an exact confirmation token

limitations: Most task-side-effect tests use SQLite, MemoryTaskDispatcher, LocalObjectStore, and fake Core; the PostgreSQL and Redis checks cover the stated concurrency and outage boundaries only.
No real Core, Symbolicator, or RustFS long-running task was used to calibrate relay or execution lease values.
The repository defaults remain legacy dispatch and compatible receipts; production outbox/strict cutover has not occurred.
No historical reconciliation apply was run against a target environment.
No full Compose deployment, target intranet hardware, remote CI, browser UAT, or production observation was executed.
